[Erowid Note: 
While it may be that the substance described is pure MDMA, Ecstasy/Molly tablets and powders are notoriously impure, misrepresented, or adulterated. Ecstasy sold in retail contexts such as festivals or parties often contain chemicals other than MDMA.]
My MDMA Experiences
I have been taking MDMA for about 6 months, I do it roughly 2 - 3 times a month. I never needed less than half a gram to give me a buzz. If I stick to the amount I take usually, I get a pleasant experience, but never reached the feeling I did on the 1st time, where I could hear voices, my vision was blurry but colours became alive.
